newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bank deposits rise 3.8 pct in February.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bank deposits rise 3.8 pct in February.

text.p: Total deposits in Venezuelan commercial banks rose 191 billion bolivars, or 3.8 percent, to 5.209 trillion bolivars ($10.9 billion) in February, from 5.018 trillion bolivars in December, according to the financial consultants Softline Consultores.
In the survey of 40 banks, 43 percent of total deposits were in current accounts and 35 percent in savings accounts. The remainder were in sight deposits and time deposits, Softline said.
Credit portfolios grew by 113 billion bolivars, or 4.9 percent in January to 2.409 trillion bolivars.

Among leading banks, Banco Provincial clung onto the top spot with 23.8 percent of total deposits followed by Banco Mercantil with 13.3 percent, Banco Venezuela with 9.3 percent, Banco Union with 7.0 percent and Banco Consolidado with 6.8 percent.
